question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes a situation where the only available option was a half-day program.
 
• The word "available" fits best in this context, indicating that the only option was accessible, but limited.
 
• The other options such as "futile," "nonviable," and "inaccessible" don't convey the idea of a choice being offered, only limited in nature.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Sentence: *The only (4) **available __**option was a half-day program that would bus students to a day-care centre on the outskirts of the town for the afternoon. *

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: **"Futile"** implies something that has no purpose, which doesn't fit the context of offering a choice.
 
• Option 3:** "Nonviable" **means something that is not practical or feasible, which isn't the case here as the program was still an option, just limited.
 
• Option 4: **"Inaccessible"** implies something that cannot be reached or obtained, which is not the case with the half-day program option.
